title: Brandon Richardson Joins The Drake Law Firm P.C. as Associate Attorney

content.rendered:
Marie Drake, Attorney, and Founder of The Drake Law Firm, P.C., a full-service law firm based in Golden, Colorado that focuses on family law, business law, and real estate, announces the addition of Associate Attorney Brandon Richardson. “We’re thrilled to welcome Brandon to The Drake Law Firm team,” says Drake. “As a leader, you look for certain qualities in all new hires. Our firm focuses on people with tremendous intellect, a great work ethic, and integrity. Brandon hits the bullseye in all of these categories. I expect great things from him in the years to come and am thrilled that he has joined our team.”

Before joining The Drake Law Firm, P.C., Richardson worked as a Legal Assistant for the Immigration Law Clinic at Tulsa University and as an Extern for the Honorable Judge Linda G. Morrissey. He graduated from Colorado State University in Fort Collins, Colorado, and received his J.D. Degree from the University of Tulsa College of Law. Richardson also realizes the importance of community service and has previously volunteered as an organizer, care handler, and at a domestic abuse shelter.

Richardson says that “one of his favorite things about working at The Drake Law Firm is that you really feel you are an integral part of the team. Everyone is working together to serve the best interests of the clients.” He is excited to be part of The Drake Law Firm, P.C., and looks forward to working on behalf of the clients.

When Richardson is not working, he enjoys hiking, backpacking, and paddle boarding during the summer months and getting out his skis and snowboard when the snow falls.

About The Drake Law Firm

The Drake Law Firm, P.C. is a full-service law firm that focuses on family law, business law, and real estate. While some disputes require litigation, we are also successful at achieving our clients’ goals before trial through settlement. At the Drake Law Firm, P.C., we believe in listening to our clients and helping them meet their goals. We proudly serve Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region.

To schedule your free 15-minute consultation, call (303) 261-8111 or fill out our contact us form.
